title: Digital Pinball: Necronomicon: Revelations (Demo)
native_title: デジタルピンボール 「ネクロノミコン」 レベレーションズ
overview:
A trial version of Digital Pinball: Necronomicon, KAZe's pinball simulation built around the dark mythology of H. P. Lovecraft.

Keep the ball in play on tables steeped in occult horror and build your score. The full game features three tables - Arkham, Cult of the Bloody Tongue and Dreamlands - for one or two players, with scores saved to backup memory.
